excerpt_intro: Below are parts of sermons the user wrote. Use them only for tone and structure; do not copy their sentences.
no_requote: Do not quote or copy, verse by verse, the text of any other translation the user imported into this app. Quote only the passage text given above.
keywords_intro: Use at least one of these keywords in the purpose of each light remark.
output_lines: Answer only in the JSON format below.
- sermon: the message draft, with title and body. Write the body as introduction, explanation of the passage, 2–3 applications, and a closing prayer.
- sermon.body must be {min}–{max} words. [[QUOTE ...]] markers do not count as words.
- examples: exactly 2 everyday examples. Put the supporting verses in each example's verse_refs.
- humor: exactly 2 light remarks. In purpose, say in one sentence how the remark supports the message of the passage.
- In verse_refs and [[QUOTE ...]] use only references from [Data: Passage], written like "JHN 15:5" or "JHN 15:1-3".
